scope: Global rules Activity recreation crash regression and committed-sheet exit

incident.exception: java.lang.ClassCastException: androidx.compose.runtime.ParcelableSnapshotMutableState cannot be cast to androidx.compose.runtime.MutableLongState
incident.trigger: MainActivity recreation while the global rules page was active
incident.cause: rememberSaveable restored the sort revision as ParcelableSnapshotMutableState while the caller expected MutableLongState.

implementation.change: GlobalRulesPage sortVersion now uses rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(0L) } so save and restore use the same state implementation.
implementation.regressionAssertion: After recreation the test waits for extension_rule_confirm to leave the semantics tree before interacting with the rules list; this lets the committed editor sheet finish its exit transition before list assertions.

flutterReference.comparison: Flutter keeps the query as ordinary StatefulWidget state and has no equivalent specialized Kotlin saveable long-state contract; the source was read-only and no Flutter code was merged or changed.

covered: real MainActivity navigation to global DNS and global rules
save a rule, recreate Activity and read the committed Room value
committed editor sheet completes dismissal before returning to list assertions
restore global DNS, global rules, profile rows, selected profile and STOPPED runtime in finally

nonFinalAttempts.result: The first post-fix run passed both Activity recreations but matched the saved rule text in the list and the still-exiting editor sheet; the test now waits for the sheet confirmation node to disappear before asserting the list.

A later launch was covered by Android POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission UI after package reinstall. The permission was temporarily granted only to the isolated Motion package for the final run; Motion and test packages were removed afterwards.

limits: This closes a Compose saveable-state crash regression and a page-state restoration assertion; it does not establish Flutter visual parity for the global rules page.
No full Flutter MainActivity comparison or continuous-transition recording was performed.
Menu dropped-frame, global Perfetto discarded owner and formal R8 GPU/fence attribution remain open; no stable performance gain is claimed.
